question: What happens when the mass of objects is emitted into the five self-powers?
premises: Afterward the mass of objects is emitted.
This emission occurs through conditions of variegation.
It unfolds in the five powers of one's own self, which are not separated as distinct beings.
inference: The emitted world of objects appears through variegating conditions within the five nonseparate powers of the self.
plain_english: Afterward, when the mass of objects has been emitted, through connection with the conditions of its variegation it appears in the five powers of one's own self, which are not divided into separate beings.
